entries.title: Precision, recall, reciprocal rank
entries.use: Did search return the right pages, and how early?
entries.blind: Needs relevance labels, and precision caps below 1 when few pages are relevant.

entries.title: nDCG@k
entries.use: Rank a list when some results are better than others.
entries.blind: A result nobody graded counts as 0.

entries.title: RAG evals
entries.use: Was the answer grounded in what was retrieved?
entries.blind: A faithful answer can still be wrong if the context is stale.

entries.title: Exact match and F1
entries.use: Compare a short answer to a reference.

entries.title: pass@k
entries.use: Does generated code pass the tests?
entries.blind: Weak tests let wrong code pass.

entries.title: LLM as judge
entries.blind: It favours the first answer shown and the longer answer.

entries.title: Pairwise preference and Elo
entries.blind: A single rating cannot show a cycle of wins.

entries.title: Human agreement and kappa
entries.use: Check that your labels can be trusted.
entries.blind: A rare label makes kappa unstable.

entries.title: Agent evals
entries.use: Did the agent finish the task, every time?
entries.blind: An end-state check cannot see a broken rule on the way.

entries.title: Is 82% better than 80%?
entries.use: How much to trust any score.
entries.blind: The simple range fails at 0% and 100%.

entries.title: Contamination and Goodhart
entries.use: Whether the test is still a fair test.
entries.blind: A small leak hides in the noise.
